tagline: The cheapest way to finish any SBC
brief: A free, read-only Chrome extension for the EA SPORTS FC 27 Web App. It finds the cheapest squad for an SBC from your own club and pre-fills market searches for the rest. It never buys.
criteria: Bold and gamer, clearly a fox, readable as a 16 px toolbar icon, distinct from FUT.GG (orange), FUTGenie (gold), FUTBIN (blue) and from MetaMask's faceted fox.

concepts.name: Bandit
concepts.idea: A fox in a bandit mask: the sly one who finds the cheap squad.
rationale: Glowing lime eyes: the colour of a full chemistry link
Every edge on a 15° grid; ear cut-outs drop out below 24 px
Violet and lime are unused by the big FUT sites

recommendation: Bandit, in Fox Violet and Chem Lime on Night.
